Carmen (AE): Handing off BeaconPulse pilot to Priya (CSM). Snapshot: 25-seat pilot, pilot kickoff target 2026-06-10, Okta SAML SSO, customer asks for audit-export & 12mo retention. They've signaled price sensitivity -> moderate renewal risk unless we show cost ops.
Priya (CSM): Thanks Carmen. Please drop runbook + any compliance artifacts and the expected daily prompts. I'll build a health timeline and owner list.
Carmen (AE): Runbook: https://redwood.internal/deals/beaconpulse. Daily prompts ~800, peak spikes ~2.5k during reporting windows. Uploaded sample dataset and SAML metadata.
Dev (Solutions): I'll own enablement and the hands-on lab. Need two prod-like datasets, non-prod API key, and top-5 admin emails for RBAC.
Abe (Support Eng): Quick infra flag: provided CIDR 10.12.0.0/16 overlaps staging. Also SAML digest mismatch. Opening ticket RED-14220.
ticket-bot: RED-14220 created and assigned to eng-infra.
Priya (CSM): Adding preflight: CIDR reconciliation, SAML validation, audit-export config, SOC2 docs. Scheduling kickoff Mon 09:00 PT.
Dev (Solutions): I'll prepare a 45m demo + 30m lab; will also draft a one-page cost note (batching + prefix cache + model choice). Due Thu.
Abe (Support Eng): Note: if HSM/KMS required lead time ~5 weeks. Cloud KMS available faster. Marking CIDR & SAML as blockers.
Carmen (AE): Customer prefers cloud KMS for pilot and will confirm procurement cadence.
Priya (CSM): Owners & next steps:
- Priya: kickoff, weekly health checks, renewal-watch label.
- Dev: enablement materials + cost note (Thu).
- Abe: RED-14220 infra ticket + SAML/CIDR resolution.
- Carmen: confirm procurement contact and datasets.
Abe (Support Eng): RED-14220 updated with required IAM role and egress list. :white_check_mark:
Priya (CSM): I'll post a short recap after kickoff and attach the initial health score. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
